column1: # RETRACTED 2026-09-17 (referee audit). The 'absent' calls in this table are a METHOD
# ARTEFACT, not biology. Reciprocal best hits cannot resolve a recent paralogue radiation:
# in Haemonchus one protein reciprocates with dop-5 at 976 bits while reverse hits pile onto
# dop-4 and dop-1 indiscriminately. Every 'absent' below means 'reciprocated to a DIFFERENT
# PARALOGUE', not 'no orthologue exists'. Confirmed counterexamples already in ~/data/proteomes/:
#   Necator dop-6 (RBH 1110/1121 bits, 81.7%), Strongyloides dop-6, Haemonchus dop-5.
# Only the dop-2 column survives (present in all six species, shared with Drosophila).
# Dating this radiation requires PHYLOGENETIC PLACEMENT. Do not read this table as a result.
